title: Rotation Neglect for In-Rotation Pieces
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:wristtime reference_number=* days_since_wear=*
| where days_since_wear>21
| sort - days_since_wear
| table reference_number brand days_since_wear wear_hours
description: Lists watches in the active rotation not worn for more than twenty-one days.
value: Unworn rotation pieces still need winding and wear to keep oils distributed and straps from dry rotting.
implementation: Log each wear session with `days_since_wear` and review neglected references monthly.
visualization: Table of references sorted by days since last wear.
grandmaExplanation: It counts watches in your rotation you have not worn in three weeks or more.
